title: Canonical Lead Candidate Contract v1.1
description: Validatable JSON Schema for the v1.1 Lead Candidate contract (LEAD_INBOX_SPEC.md section 1). This is the ONLY shape external automation may POST to /api/v1/lead-candidates and the ONLY shape the Lead Inbox persists. Fail-closed: any instance failing validation is quarantined (moved, never dropped) with an alert card. The consent firewall is encoded structurally below as schema constraints, not advisory prose.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Unknown versions are quarantined, never best-effort parsed.

lead_id.description: Assigned by the Inbox, never by the producer. Producers MUST omit or send null; the boundary discards any producer-supplied value. Persisted/normalised records MUST have it non-null. Pattern accepts both the existing LD-<12hex> mint and RFC-4122 uuid (convergence decision at implementation).

idempotency_key.description: 'source:external_id'. UNIQUE at the boundary and in storage. Replays with the same key MUST NOT create a second lead (they return the original receipt).

candidate_type.description: Canonical taxonomy (blueprint section 4 / OPUS mission LEAD CLASSIFICATION RULE). Exactly one. A signal is not a lead; a public business is not residential consent.

channel.description: Exactly the SPEC section-1 enum. 'synthetic_test' is the hard-blocked-at-EffectorGate test channel. Existing producers email_inbound.py / harvest_austender.py map to 'other' until the Owner approves an enum extension (open question).

source_id.description: Producer identifier. MUST match an entry in the per-source HMAC allowlist (X-Octopus-Source header); mismatch => quarantine.

external_id.description: Producer-side stable id of the underlying artefact (form submission id, DA number, FB post id, telegram message id).

received_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Replaces the epoch-float created_ts of the legacy inbox.

contact.description: All-null allowed (market_signal usually has no contact). Suppression list is checked against phone/email BEFORE any draft is proposed (SPEC section 2).

evidence.description: e.g. submitted_quote_form | office_contact_conspicuously_published | owner_logged_inbound_request. MUST be non-null whenever outreach_allowed=true (enforced below).

outreach_allowed.description: Fail-closed default false. May be true ONLY under the conditional rules in allOf below. This field authorises DRAFTING outreach; it never authorises sending (external_send_allowed governs that and is const false here).

scope_text.description: Required — whatever was actually observed. Canonical successor of both legacy fields 'description' (lead_sense) and 'raw_text' (lead_leg_inbox).

items.description: Attachment isolation: by REFERENCE only (scanned before touch). Inline data: URIs are structurally rejected.

score.description: Compat field: the existing single deterministic score from lead_scorer.py (0-100 clamp). Kept so the existing scorer feeds this contract unchanged while the 3-score split is introduced.

action.description: Compat field: lead_scorer action thresholds (>=70 draft, 45-69 save, <45 skip).

category.description: Compat field: lead_scorer category (strata_remedial / government_education / new_residential_multi / commercial_fitout / uncategorised / filtered).

missing_questions.description: LeadQualificationLeg missing-question detection output (blueprint P0 table). Low parse confidence => clarify card, never a guess.

risk_flags.description: Flags are RAISED here, never cleared (fail-closed licensing per blueprint R4 + section 9.6). Any licence-class flag forces workflow.quote_status=REQUIRES_LICENCE_REVIEW downstream.

qualification.description: Inbox-owned block. Producers should omit; the boundary materialises zeros and LeadQualificationLeg fills it.

status.description: Inbox/qualification lifecycle only. The full funnel (sent/replied/inspection/won/lost/paid) is DERIVED from the append-only event stream (03_EVENT_CONTRACT.json), never mutated into this field.

external_send_allowed.description: HARD INVARIANT: const false in this contract. No instance at or behind the ingestion boundary can ever carry true. The only flip path is owner verdict -> LANGAR append -> EffectorGate release, which lives OUTSIDE this contract (effect records, not lead candidates). A submission carrying true fails validation and is quarantined.

quote_status.description: Fail-closed licensing (blueprint R4): uncertain => REQUIRES_LICENCE_REVIEW and the quote stays internal until the Owner confirms on the card.

workflow.description: Inbox-owned block. Producers should omit; boundary injects {status:received, owner_action_required:true, external_send_allowed:false, next_action:qualify}.

x-firewall-summary: market_signal can NEVER carry outreach_allowed=true (schema const).
basis none/unknown => outreach_allowed=false (missing consent fails closed).
outreach_allowed=true requires: type in {consented_inbound, public_b2b} AND basis in {explicit, inferred_business} AND non-null evidence AND compliance_reason.
public_b2b can never masquerade as residential consent (basis 'explicit' forbidden for it); consented_inbound requires basis=explicit.
external_send_allowed is const false in this contract — producers and legs structurally cannot grant sending; only verdict->LANGAR->EffectorGate can, outside this schema.
synthetic_test is pinned to consented_inbound with null contact endpoints (defense-in-depth under the EffectorGate by-type hard block).

x-submission-profile.note: Producers POST a subset: they MUST send schema_version, idempotency_key, candidate_type, source, consent, request (contact/property optional) and MUST NOT send lead_id/qualification/workflow. The boundary injects inbox-owned defaults (lead_id mint; qualification zeros; workflow {received,true,false,qualify}) and then validates the persisted record against this full schema. Producer-supplied workflow/qualification, or any consent uplift that fails the allOf rules, => quarantine + alert card, never silent drop.

proposed_new_default_off: OCTOPUS_WIRE_LEAD_CANDIDATES — enables the signed /api/v1/lead-candidates boundary; off => endpoint absent, nothing accepted
OCTOPUS_WIRE_CONSENT_FIREWALL — enables classification/persist of the consent block; off => no candidate gains outreach_allowed (defaults keep everything false = fail-closed)
